sources.entry: Journey.io - Journey.io is a storytelling platform that enables users to create interactive presentations, combining videos, slides, text, and embeds to captivate their audience. #freemium

summary.name: Journey
summary.one_liner: Journey.io is a sales and presentation platform that packages pitch decks, case studies, videos and follow-up docs into one branded, trackable page that buyers can share internally.
keywords: alternative to sending pitch deck links
use_cases: Sharing a pitch deck with decision-makers
Packaging case studies for a prospect
Tracking which buyers view a deck and for how long
Sending follow-up documents after a sales call
Giving buyers one place for all decision materials
summary.what_it_does: Journey lets users combine slides, documents, videos, embeds and text into a single branded page with a shareable link. Pages can be organized so the audience knows what to read and in what order. Users can drag and drop existing documents rather than hunting through email threads. The page reports who engaged, what they viewed, and how long they spent, so the sender can decide next steps. The page lists integrations with tools such as Google Slides, Notion, Loom, YouTube, Calendly, DocuSign and PDF, plus "and more".
notable: Single shareable branded page combining decks, docs, videos and embeds
Engagement tracking showing viewers, time spent and content viewed
Drag-and-drop packaging of documents already being sent
Integrations listed include Loom, YouTube, Calendly, Notion, DocuSign, Figma and many others
caveats: Paid tiers are implied but pricing details are not on the page
Page content is largely marketing; claims such as reply-rate improvement come from testimonials and are unverified
